scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,ui --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev:api:fixture" "npm run dev:ui"
scripts.dev:live: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,ui --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:ui"
scripts.dev:api: cd api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --reload-dir app --reload-dir migrations --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.dev:api:fixture: cd api && PENNILESS_SOURCE=fixture uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --reload-dir app --reload-dir migrations --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd api && uv sync && cd ../ui && npm install
